12.madueke_b: To whom God said: Let it not seem grievous to thee for the boy, and for thy handmaid: all things that Sara shall say to thee, hear her voice: because in Isaac shall seed be called to thee.

13.s_dismas: But the ſonne alſo of the handmaid I wil make into a great nation, becauſe he is thy ſeede.
13.odr_com: But the sonne also of the handmaid I wil make into a great nation, because he is thy seede.
13.sabates_a: But the son also of the handmaid I will make into a great nation, because he is thy seed.
13.madueke_b: But the son also of the handmaid I will make into a great nation, because he is thy seed.

14.s_dismas: Abraham therfore roſe vp in the morning, and taking bread and a bottle of water, put it vpon her shoulder, and deliuered the boy and diſmiſt her. Who went away, and wandred in the wilderneſſe of Berſabee.
14.odr_com: Abraham therfore rose vp in the morning, and taking bread and a bottle of water, put it vpon her shoulder, and deliuered the boy and dismist her. Who went away, and wandred in the wildernesse of Bersabee.
14.sabates_a: Abraham therefore rose up in the morning, and taking bread and a bottle of water, put it upon her shoulder, and delivered the boy, and dismissed her. Who went away, and wandered in the wilderness of Bersabee.
14.madueke_b: Abraham therefore rose up in the morning, and taking bread and a bottle of water, put it upon her shoulder, and delivered the boy, and dismissed her. Who went away, and wandered in the wilderness of Bersabee.

15.s_dismas: And when the water in the bottle was ſpent, ſhe caſt the boy vnder one of the trees, that were there.
15.odr_com: And when the water in the bottle was spent, she cast the boy vnder one of the trees, that were there.
15.sabates_a: And when the water in the bottle was spent, she cast the boy under one of the trees that were there.
15.madueke_b: And when the water in the bottle was spent, she cast the boy under one of the trees that were there.

16.s_dismas: And ſhe went her way, and ſate ouer againſt a great way of as farre as a bowe can caſt. For she ſaid: I wil no ſee the child dying: and ſitting ouer againſt, she lifted vp her voice and wept.
16.odr_com: And she went her way, and sate ouer against a great way of as farre as a bowe can cast. for she said: I wil no see the child dying: and sitting ouer against, she lifted vp her voice and wept.
16.sabates_a: And she went her way, and sat over against a great way off as far as a bow can cast, for she said: I will no see the child dying. And sitting over against, she lifted up her voice and wept.
16.madueke_b: And she went her way, and sat over against a great way off as far as a bow can cast, for she said: I will no see the child dying. And sitting over against, she lifted up her voice and wept.

17.s_dismas: And God heard the voice of the boy: and an Angel of God called Agar from heauen, ſaying: What doeſt thou Agar? feare not: for God hath heard the voice of the boy, from the place wherin he is.
17.odr_com: And God heard the voice of the boy: and an angel of God called Agar from heauen, saying: What doest thou Agar? feare not: for God hath heard the voice of the boy, from the place wherin he is.
17.sabates_a: And God heard the voice of the boy: and an Angel of God called Agar from heaven, saying: What doest thou Agar? Fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the boy, from the place wherein he is.
17.madueke_b: And God heard the voice of the boy: and an Angel of God called Agar from heaven, saying: What doest thou Agar? Fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the boy, from the place wherein he is.

18.s_dismas: Ariſe, take vp the boy, and hold his hand: for into a great nation wil I make him.
18.odr_com: Arise, take vp the boy, and hold his hand: for into a great nation wil I make him.
18.sabates_a: Arise, take up the boy, & hold his hand; for into a great nation will I make him.
18.madueke_b: Arise, take up the boy, & hold his hand; for into a great nation will I make him.

19.s_dismas: And God opened her eyes: who ſeing a wel of water, went, and filled the bottle, and gaue the boy to drinke.
19.odr_com: And God opened her eyes: who seing a wel of water, went, and filled the bottle, and gaue the boy to drinke.
19.sabates_a: And God opened her eyes: who seeing a well of water, went, and filled the bottle, and gave the boy to drink.
19.madueke_b: And God opened her eyes: who seeing a well of water, went, and filled the bottle, and gave the boy to drink.

20.s_dismas: And God was with him: who grew, and abode in the wildernes, and became a young man archer.
20.odr_com: And God was with him: who grew, and abode in the wildernes, and became a young man archer.
20.sabates_a: And God was with him: who grew, and abode in the wilderness, and became a young man archer.
20.madueke_b: And God was with him: who grew, and abode in the wilderness, and became a young man archer.

21.s_dismas: And he dwelt in the wildernes of Pharan, and his mother tooke a wife for him out of the land of Ægypt.
21.odr_com: And he dwelt in the wildernes of Pharan, and his mother tooke a wife for him out of the land of Ægypt.
21.sabates_a: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Pharan, and his mother took a wife for him out of the land of Ægypt.
21.madueke_b: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Pharan, and his mother took a wife for him out of the land of Aegypt.

22.s_dismas: The ſame time ſaid Abimelech, and Phicol the general of his armie to Abraham: God is with thee in al things which thou doeſt.
22.odr_com: The same time said Abimelech, and Phicol the general of his armie to Abraham: God is with thee in al things which thou doest.
22.sabates_a: The same time said Abimelech, and Phicol the General of his army, to Abraham: God is with thee in all things which thou doest.
22.madueke_b: The same time said Abimelech, and Phicol the General of his army, to Abraham: God is with thee in all things which thou doest.

23.s_dismas: Sweare therfore by God, not to hurt me, and my poſteritie, and my ſtocke: but according to the mercie, that I haue done thee, thou ſhalt doe to me, and to the land wherin thou haſt liued a ſtranger.
23.odr_com: Sweare therfore by God, not to hurt me, and my posteritie, and my stocke: but according to the mercie, that I haue done thee, thou shalt doe to me, and to the land wherin thou hast liued a stranger.
23.sabates_a: Swear therefore by God, not to hurt me, and my posterity, and my stock: but according to the mercy, that I have done thee, thou shalt do to me, and to the land wherein thou hast lived a stranger.
23.madueke_b: Swear therefore by God, not to hurt me, and my posterity, and my stock: but according to the mercy, that I have done thee, thou shalt do to me, and to the land wherein thou hast lived a stranger.

24.s_dismas: And Abraham ſaid: I wil ſweare.
24.odr_com: And Abraham said: I wil sweare.
24.sabates_a: And Abraham said: I will swear.
24.madueke_b: And Abraham said: I will swear.

25.s_dismas: And he rebuked Abimelech for the wel of water, which his ſeruants had taken away by force.
25.odr_com: And he rebuked Abimelech for the wel of water, which his seruants had taken away by force.
25.sabates_a: And he rebuked Abimelech for the well of water, which his servants had taken away by force.
25.madueke_b: And he rebuked Abimelech for the well of water, which his servants had taken away by force.

26.s_dismas: And Abimelech anſwered: I knew not who did this thing: yea and thy ſelfe dideſt not tel me, and I heard not of it but to day.
26.odr_com: And Abimelech answered: I knew not who did this thing: yea and thy selfe didest not tel me, and I heard not of it but to day.
26.sabates_a: And Abimelech answered: I knew not who did this thing: yea and thyself didst not tell me, and I heard not of it but today.
26.madueke_b: And Abimelech answered: I knew not who did this thing: yea and thyself didst not tell me, and I heard not of it but today.

27.s_dismas: Abraham therfore tooke ſheepe and oxen, and gaue to Abimelech: and both of them made a league.
27.odr_com: Abraham therfore tooke sheepe and oxen, and gaue to Abimelech: and both of them made a league.
27.sabates_a: Abraham therefore took sheep and oxen, and gave to Abimelech: and both of them made a league.
27.madueke_b: Abraham therefore took sheep and oxen, and gave to Abimelech: and both of them made a league.

28.s_dismas: And Abraham ſet ſeuen ewe lambes of the flocke apart.
28.odr_com: And Abraham set seuen ewe lambes of the flocke apart.
28.sabates_a: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock apart.
28.madueke_b: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock apart.

29.s_dismas: To whom Abimelech ſaid: What meane theſe ſeuen ewe lambes, which thou haſt made to ſtand apart?
29.odr_com: To whom Abimelech said: What meane these seuen ewe lambes, which thou hast made to stand apart?
29.sabates_a: To whom Abimelech said: What mean these seven ewe lambs, which thou hast made to stand apart?
29.madueke_b: To whom Abimelech said: What mean these seven ewe lambs, which thou hast made to stand apart?

30.s_dismas: But he ſaid: Seuen ewe lambes ſhalt thou take at my hand: that they may be a teſtimonie for me, that I digged this wel.
30.odr_com: But he said: Seuen ewe lambes shalt thou take at my hand: that they may be a testimonie for me, that I digged this wel.
30.sabates_a: But he said: Seven ewe lambs shalt thou take at my hand: that they may be a testimony for me, that I digged this well.
30.madueke_b: But he said: Seven ewe lambs shalt thou take at my hand: that they may be a testimony for me, that I digged this well.

31.s_dismas: Therfor vvel of oath was that place called Berſabee: becauſe there both did ſweare.
31.odr_com: Therfore was that place called Bersabee: because there both did sweare.
31.sabates_a: Therefore was that place called Bersabee: because there both did swear.
31.madueke_b: Therefore was that place called Bersabee: because there both did swear.

32.s_dismas: And they made a league for the wel of oath.
32.odr_com: And they made a league for the wel of oath.
32.sabates_a: And they made a league for the well of oath.
32.madueke_b: And they made a league for the well of oath.

33.s_dismas: And Abimelech aroſe, and Phicol the general of his armie, and they returned to the land of the Paleſtines. But Abraham planted a groue in Berſabee, and called therupon the name of our Lord God eternal.
33.odr_com: And Abimelech arose, and Phicol the general of his armie, and they returned to the land of the Palestines. But Abraham planted a groue in Bersabee, and called therupon the name of our Lord God eternal.
33.sabates_a: And Abimelech arose, and Phicol the General of his army, and they returned to the land of the Palestines. But Abraham planted a grove in Bersabee, and called there upon the name of our Lord God eternal.
33.madueke_b: And Abimelech arose, and Phicol the General of his army, and they returned to the land of the Palestines. But Abraham planted a grove in Bersabee, and called there upon the name of our Lord God eternal.

34.s_dismas: And he was a ſeiorner in the land of the Paleſtines manie dayes.
34.odr_com: And he was a seiorner in the land of the Palestines manie dayes.
34.sabates_a: And he was a sojourner in the land of the Palestines many days.
34.madueke_b: And he was a sojourner in the land of the Palestines many days.

janvier_by_verse.1: And our Lord visited Sara, as he had promised: and fulfilled the things which he spake.
janvier_by_verse.2: And she conceived & bare a son in her old age, at the time that God had foretold her.
janvier_by_verse.3: And Abraham called the name of his son, which Sara bare him, Isaac:
janvier_by_verse.4: and he circumcised him the eighth day, as God had commanded him,
janvier_by_verse.5: when he was an hundred years old: for at this age of his father, was Isaac born.
janvier_by_verse.6: And Sara said: Laughter God hath made to me: whosoever shall hear of it, will laugh with me.
janvier_by_verse.7: And again she said: Who that shall hear of it would believe Abraham, that Sara gave suck to a son, which she bare him now being an old man?
janvier_by_verse.8: The child therefore grew and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast in the day of his weaning.
janvier_by_verse.9: And when Sara had seen the son of Agar the Ægyptian playing with Isaac her son, she said to Abraham:
janvier_by_verse.10: Cast out this handmaid, & her son: for the son of the handmaid shall not be heir with my son Isaac.
janvier_by_verse.11: Abraham took this grievously for his son.
janvier_by_verse.12: To whom God said: Let it not seem grievous to thee for the boy, and for thy handmaid: all things that Sara shall say to thee, hear her voice: because in Isaac shall seed be called to thee.
janvier_by_verse.13: But the son also of the handmaid I will make into a great nation, because he is thy seed.
janvier_by_verse.14: Abraham therefore rose up in the morning, and taking bread and a bottle of water, put it upon her shoulder, and delivered the boy, and dismissed her. Who went away, and wandered in the wilderness of Bersabee.
janvier_by_verse.15: And when the water in the bottle was spent, she cast the boy under one of the trees that were there.
janvier_by_verse.16: And she went her way, and sat over against a great way off as far as a bow can cast, for she said: I will no see the child dying. And sitting over against, she lifted up her voice and wept.
janvier_by_verse.17: And God heard the voice of the boy: and an Angel of God called Agar from heaven, saying: What doest thou Agar? Fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the boy, from the place wherein he is.
janvier_by_verse.18: Arise, take up the boy, & hold his hand; for into a great nation will I make him.
janvier_by_verse.19: And God opened her eyes: who seeing a well of water, went, and filled the bottle, and gave the boy to drink.
janvier_by_verse.20: And God was with him: who grew, and abode in the wilderness, and became a young man archer.
janvier_by_verse.21: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Pharan, and his mother took a wife for him out of the land of Ægypt.
janvier_by_verse.22: The same time said Abimelech, and Phicol the General of his army, to Abraham: God is with thee in all things which thou doest.
janvier_by_verse.23: Swear therefore by God, not to hurt me, and my posterity, and my stock: but according to the mercy, that I have done thee, thou shalt do to me, and to the land wherein thou hast lived a stranger.
janvier_by_verse.24: And Abraham said: I will swear.
janvier_by_verse.25: And he rebuked Abimelech for the well of water, which his servants had taken away by force.
janvier_by_verse.26: And Abimelech answered: I knew not who did this thing: yea and thyself didst not tell me, and I heard not of it but today.
janvier_by_verse.27: Abraham therefore took sheep and oxen, and gave to Abimelech: and both of them made a league.
janvier_by_verse.28: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock apart.
janvier_by_verse.29: To whom Abimelech said: What mean these seven ewe lambs, which thou hast made to stand apart?
janvier_by_verse.30: But he said: Seven ewe lambs shalt thou take at my hand: that they may be a testimony for me, that I digged this well.
janvier_by_verse.31: Therefore was that place called Bersabee: because there both did swear.
janvier_by_verse.32: And they made a league for the well of oath.
janvier_by_verse.33: And Abimelech arose, and Phicol the General of his army, and they returned to the land of the Palestines. But Abraham planted a grove in Bersabee, and called there upon the name of our Lord God eternal.
janvier_by_verse.34: And he was a sojourner in the land of the Palestines many days.
